# netskope_aig_token_group (Data Source)

Manages an AI Gateway token group. Token groups are named collections of API tokens used in rate limit rule criteria to identify and throttle specific client applications or users.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netskope_aig_token_group" "my_aigtokengroup" {
  id = "019812aa-bdba-7a48-baa2-2de8c6006fda"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the token group.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the token group.
- `name` (String) Name of the token group.
- `token_count` (Number) Number of tokens in this group.
